faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DEO Thanjavur Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DEO Thanjavur Office Assistant recruitment is 05-10-2026. Candidates are advised to ensure their applications reach the office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Office Assistant post is an 8th Standard Pass. Additionally, candidates must have studied in Tamil medium in a Government school.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to the Office Assistant position is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 37 years. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Office Assistant post ranges from Rs. 15700 to Rs. 58100 per month, as per Level-1 of the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DEO Thanjavur Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test, followed by Document Verification, and finally the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 1/n2/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Which district is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for the District Education Office Thanjavur, located in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Education Office Thanjavur. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
